5493.title: Rail visibility editor activates destinations
5493.rootCauseOneLine: The rail visibility editor supplies activation and exit callbacks, overriding the shared control's existing row-toggle behavior.
5493.proposedFix: Remove activation/exit callbacks only from the rail visibility editor and cover plugin/command row toggling in desktop/compact layouts.
5493.caveats: Component DOM reproduction; native desktop wrapper and hover cursor appearance were not tested. Browser Automation could not open because Chrome/Chromium is absent.
